Reply with JSON only: {"votes":[{"ref":"<auditor>:<id>","vote":"AGREE|DISAGREE","reason":"..."}],"missed":[{"severity":"...","file":"...","line":0,"issue":"...","evidence":"...","fix":"..."}]}

AUDIT QUESTION: pp-selectid (Protocol Pulse clip-video builder), RULINGS 152 (1) and 154 (2), uncommitted (diff below). THE RULINGS: "the writer chain: every answering Heimdall family (qwen, deepseek, gpt-oss, gemma, minimax; glm only if probed), 120 s each, then Grok. Probe before the build." and "In the never-empty pass the hook bar is soft; an unrated opener opens flagged." THE CODE: proof_ly.WRITERS (the writer chain), package.WRITER_DEADLINE_S = 120 (every writer call passes it as deadline_s), proof_ledger.writer_probe (probes every Heimdall writer at once, marks the ones that do not answer down for the run; Grok never probed; a replayed run probes nothing). package.hook_unrated (line 1898): the plain reason a hook has no rating ON the calibrated bar (no valid calibration, no rating, or a rating by another back-end than the bar's rater); hook_own (line 1917) lets such a hook pass, flagged and marked "unrated", ONLY when the never-empty pass marked it (hook_bar_soft); the stage 2b block marks at most HOOK_SOFT_MAX (2, line 1111) openers: first those its own rater rated under the bar (hook_bar_under, line 1883, unchanged), then unrated ones. _can_open (line 1989, unchanged) reads hook_own's "passes"; _live_bar (line 1809) is the calibration.
CHECK, quoting the code: can an unrated or off-bar hook open in the CLEAN pass or without its flag; can more than HOOK_SOFT_MAX hooks be marked; can a hook that cannot open for another reason (G17a onset, the STAND_ALONE hook rule, its frames) open now; can hook_own's new branch break a caller that reads its "rating" as an int; can the probe mark a family down that answered, keep one up that did not, run against recordings, or block the build past its timeout; does every writer call keep the 120 s deadline. Report only what the code shows.

CODE:

+    """RULING 154 (2) (orchestrator 20:36 ET Nov 23): "In the never-empty pass the hook bar is soft; an unrated opener

+    own rater (ruling 154 (1)'s stand-in judge); None when the bar's own rater rated it (hook_bar_under then says
+    whether it is under the bar)."""
+    r = (m or {}).get("hook_rating") or {}
+    live, _ = _live_bar()
+    if live is None:
+        return "the hook bar has no valid calibration today"
+    if not all(isinstance(r.get(k), int) and not isinstance(r.get(k), bool) for k in HOOK_PARTS):
+        w = str(r.get("why") or "")

 def hook_own(m):

@@ -1903,13 +1923,17 @@ def hook_own(m):

+                short=why if live is None else short,                     # RULING 154 (2): rated off the bar too
                 bar=HB.text(live), source="the hook's cached own-job rating (ruling 61), on the calibrated bar (ruling 115)",
-                rule=HOOK_OWN_RULE, **({"flagged": flag} if flag else {}))
+                rule=HOOK_OWN_RULE, **({"flagged": flag or un} if flag or un else {}), **({"unrated": True} if un else {}))

diff --git a/tests/package/proof_ledger.py b/tests/package/proof_ledger.py
index 551e0681c..32aa0c512 100644
--- a/tests/package/proof_ledger.py
+++ b/tests/package/proof_ledger.py
@@ -313,4 +312,44 @@ def build_router(routing, shadow, shadow_log, limit=None):
 
 
+WRITER_PROBE_S = 45.0                            # RULING 152 (1): one probe answer waits at most this long
+
+
+def writer_probe(router, timeout_s=WRITER_PROBE_S):
+    """RULING 152 (1) (orchestrator 19:36 ET Nov 23): "Probe which families answer BEFORE the build and skip the ones
+    that do not." Every Heimdall leg of the router's writer chain (proof_ly.WRITERS) is asked a one-word question, all
+    at once, timeout_s each, as a ruling-87 probe (role "probe87:<name>": live, never recorded nor served from a
+    recording). A family that does not answer is marked down for this run, so no writer call waits out its deadline on
+    it; Grok (the chain's non-Heimdall leg) is never probed and stays last. A replayed run (router.replay) probes
+    nothing: its recordings decide. -> {name: {"answers": bool, "seconds": float[, "why": str]}}."""
+    import threading
+    if getattr(router, "replay", False):
+        return {}
+    names = [n for n in router.chain("angle_write") if P.gateway(router.backends[n]) == "heimdall"]
+    out, lock = {}, threading.Lock()
+
+    def ask(n):
+        router.chains.setdefault(f"probe87:{n}", [n])
+        t0 = time.time()
+        try:
+            r = router.call(f"probe87:{n}", "Reply with the single word OK.", 64, 7, deadline_s=timeout_s)
+            text = (getattr(r, "text", "") or "").strip()
+            v = {"answers": bool(text), "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1), **({} if text else {"why": "empty"})}
+        except Exception as e:                             # noqa: BLE001  any failure: not answering today
+            v = {"answers": False, "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1), "why": f"{type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:120]}"}
+        with lock:
+            out[n] = v
+    ts = [threading.Thread(target=ask, args=(n,), daemon=True) for n in names]
+    for t in ts:
+        t.start()
+    for t in ts:
+        t.join(timeout_s + 15)
+    with lock:
+        for n in names:
+            v = out.setdefault(n, {"answers": False, "seconds": timeout_s, "why": "no answer in time"})
+            if not v["answers"]:
+                router.down[n] = f"did not answer the writer probe (ruling 152 (1)): {v.get('why', '')}"[:200]
+        return dict(out)
+
+
 def applied(router):
     """RULING 100: which rows of the deadline table the build's router uses: a verdict pair on which a deadline applies
@@ -570,4 +592,9 @@ def main(argv=None):
     say(f"  routing (ruling 85): {router.routing}; now {router.mode()} (ruling 87: the shared Heimdall health)"
         + (f"; SHADOW (ruling 86 / 115): {shadow}" if shadow else ""))
+    wprobe = writer_probe(router)                # RULING 152 (1): the writers that answer, in order, then Grok
+    say("  RULING 152 (1): the writers " + " -> ".join(n for n in router.chain("angle_write") if n not in router.down)
+        + f", {PK.WRITER_DEADLINE_S:g} s each; probe: " + ("; ".join(
+            f"{n.split(':', 1)[1]} {'answers' if v['answers'] else 'SKIPPED (' + str(v.get('why')) + ')'} {v['seconds']} s"
+            for n, v in wprobe.items()) or "none (a replayed run)"))
     live, live_why = PK.hook_live_bar()          # RULING 115: the bar in every build line, its floors and its sha
     say(f"  RULING 115: {HB.text(live)}; the hook list {router.chain('coherence_verdict', 'hook')}"
